data.title: Hagrid speaking
data.statement:
Help J. K. Rowling in her writing. Indeed, Hagrid has a distinctive way of speaking.

<<Replace the letter and the words>>
The final letter of each word is replaced by {{'}} if it is {{f}}, {{t}}, {{d}} or {{g}} or their capital letter.
The first letter of each word is replaced by {{'}} if it is {{h}} of {{H}}.
The word {{you}} is replaced by the word {{yeh}}.
The word {{to}} is replaced by the word {{ter}}.
The word {{and}} is replaced by the word {{an'}}.
The word {{me}} is replaced by the word {{meh}}.

<<You have to be careful to modify only Hagrid's sentences.>>
The sentences are considered as a Hagrid speaking if Hagrid is mentioned as the speaker, in other words, outside the quotation marks. 
For example : 
✅"You going to the forest?" Asked Hagrid. => Hagrid is the speaker in this sentence because he is mentionned outside the quotation marks.
❌"No it's ok Hagrid. I just want to reach the castle before lunch." Replied Harry fearfully. => Hagrid is <<NOT>> the speaker in this sentence because he is <<NOT>> mentioned outside the quotation marks.

<<The punctuation must not be altered.>>
If a word is part of a hyphenated term like "can't", "right-handed" or "it's" it should not be modified. 
A word is considered a word when it is separated from its neighbors by a space. If a word ends with punctuation, care must be taken to modify it accordingly, as if the punctuation were not there.

<<Take care of the case sensitive.>>
The transformation must preserve the original case sensitivity. 
For example: 
`YoU => YeH
going => goin'`

testCases.title: Simple sentences
testCases.testIn:
2
"You going to the forest?" Asked Hagrid.
"No it's ok Hagrid. I just want to reach the castle before lunch." Replied Harry fearfully.
testCases.testOut:
"Yeh goin' ter the fores'?" Asked Hagrid.
"No it's ok Hagrid. I just want to reach the castle before lunch." Replied Harry fearfully.

testCases.testIn:
2
"You going to forest? Let me guide you." Something Hagrid.
"No change at all" Said Harry.
testCases.testOut:
"Yeh goin' ter fores'? Le' meh guide yeh." Something Hagrid.
"No change at all" Said Harry.

testCases.title: Does Hagrid speak?
testCases.testIn:
5
"This is mad!" Ron murmured, moving his free hand gingerly up and down his horse's neck.
"You'd better hope it stays invisible," said Harry darkly.
"We all ready, then?" added Harry.
They all nodded and he saw five pairs of knees tighten beneath their robes.
Hagrid went away from the Thestrals after their takeoff.
testCases.testOut:

"You'd better hope it stays invisible," said Harry darkly.
"We all ready, then?" added Harry.
They all nodded and he saw five pairs of knees tighten beneath their robes.

testCases.title: Only t and f to replace?
testCases.testIn:
6
"Tell us about your summer and I'll tell you about mine, Hagrid." Said Harry.
Hagrid glared at him through his one open eye.
"Oh, all right" Hagrid said in a resigned voice.
He took another fortifying gulp of tea, then said.
"Well, we set off right after term ended..." Hagrid began.
"Madame Maxime went with you, then?" Hermione interjected.
testCases.testOut:
"Tell us about your summer and I'll tell you about mine, Hagrid." Said Harry.
Hagrid glared at him through his one open eye.
"Oh, all righ'" Hagrid said in a resigned voice.
He took another fortifying gulp of tea, then said.
"Well, we se' of' righ' after term ende'..." Hagrid began.
"Madame Maxime went with you, then?" Hermione interjected.

testCases.title: Very long talk
testCases.testIn:
10
"You and me have to go to the dark forest to hunt the half hound and find the hot food!" Hagrid roared.
"I do not want to go to the forest with you and him!" Ron yelled.
"Wait! What? How are you doing today? It is hot, hard, and terrifying to find food in the forest..." said Hagrid.
"You, you, you, and me, me, me, to, to, to, the, the, the forest, forest, forest!" Hagrid mumbled.
"Harry, you have to find out what happened to the dog, the half hound that we saw in the forest!" Hermione whispered.
"You have to help me, Harry! The forest is dark and full of bad things, huge dogs and hot fire!" Hagrid panicked.
"And, if you want, we can go to the pub to get a hot tea." Hagrid proposed.
"But the huge half hound had a hard tooth that could cut a tough log." Hagrid explained.
"Me and you, Harry, we are a good team to find the bad dog." Hagrid smiled.
"Tell me you did not touch the half blood dog in the dark forest!" Hagrid yelled.
testCases.testOut:
"Yeh an' meh 'ave ter go ter the dark fores' ter 'un' the 'al' 'oun' an' fin' the 'o' foo'!" Hagrid roared.
"I do not want to go to the forest with you and him!" Ron yelled.
"Wai'! Wha'? 'ow are yeh doin' today? I' is 'o', 'ar', an' terrifyin' ter fin' foo' in the fores'..." said Hagrid.
"Yeh, yeh, yeh, an' meh, meh, meh, ter, ter, ter, the, the, the fores', fores', fores'!" Hagrid mumbled.
"Harry, you have to find out what happened to the dog, the half hound that we saw in the forest!" Hermione whispered.
"Yeh 'ave ter 'elp meh, 'arry! The fores' is dark an' full o' ba' things, 'uge dogs an' 'o' fire!" Hagrid panicked.
"An', i' yeh wan', we can go ter the pub ter ge' a 'o' tea." Hagrid proposed.
"Bu' the 'uge 'al' 'oun' 'a' a 'ar' tooth tha' coul' cu' a tough lo'." Hagrid explained.
"Meh an' yeh, 'arry, we are a goo' team ter fin' the ba' do'." Hagrid smiled.
"Tell meh yeh di' no' touch the 'al' bloo' do' in the dark fores'!" Hagrid yelled.

testCases.title: Very long talk validator
testCases.testIn:
14
"Harry, hurry and hand me the huge hot dog!" Hagrid bellowed.
"You mean the youth band went to the meadow today?" Hagrid asked.
"Hagrid, did you find the food?" asked Hermione.
"It is it! And you and me... to do it? Good god!" Hagrid cried.
"If you want to go and find the half blood hound, you have to help me, Harry, to get the meat and the food to the dark forest!" Hagrid said.
"You? Me? To the forest? And why not him?" Hagrid murmured.
"I told Hagrid that he had to stay behind." Ron said.
"And and and to to to you you you me me me!" Hagrid shouted.
"Half of the giant squid went mad and hid in the mud." Hagrid noted.
"He had a hard hat, and he hit the troll hard on the head." Hagrid laughed.
"Harry, hurry and hand me the huge hot dog!" Hagrid bellowed.
"You mean the youth band went to the meadow today?" Hagrid asked.
"Hagrid, did you find the food?" asked Hermione.
"It is it! And you and me... to do it? Good god!" Hagrid cried.

"I' yeh wan' ter go an' fin' the 'al' bloo' 'oun', yeh 'ave ter 'elp meh, 'arry, ter ge' the mea' an' the foo' ter the dark fores'!" Hagrid said.
"Yeh? Meh? Ter the fores'? An' why no' 'im?" Hagrid murmured.
"I told Hagrid that he had to stay behind." Ron said.
"An' an' an' ter ter ter yeh yeh yeh meh meh meh!" Hagrid shouted.
"'al' o' the gian' squi' wen' ma' an' 'i' in the mu'." Hagrid noted.
"'e 'a' a 'ar' 'a', an' 'e 'i' the troll 'ar' on the 'ea'." Hagrid laughed.
"'arry, 'urry an' 'an' meh the 'uge 'o' do'!" Hagrid bellowed.
